# Wide Constitution

## Core Principles

### I. Readable First

Every change follows the principle of readable first.

### II. One Source of Truth

Every change follows the principle of one source of truth.

### III. Small Steps

Every change follows the principle of small steps.

### IV. Tests Before Code

Every change follows the principle of tests before code.

### V. No Hidden State

Every change follows the principle of no hidden state.

### VI. Fail Loudly

Every change follows the principle of fail loudly.

### VII. Local by Default

Every change follows the principle of local by default.

### VIII. Plain Text Wins

Every change follows the principle of plain text wins.

### IX. Measure Before Tuning

Every change follows the principle of measure before tuning.

### X. Docs Ship With Code

Every change follows the principle of docs ship with code.

### XI. Reversible Changes

Every change follows the principle of reversible changes.

## Governance

Amendments need a pull request and one review.
